{{Quote|Mandalorians, I am Master Dooku. You stand accused of murder. Surrender now and we will ensure that you are treated fairly.|Dooku|<ref name="JF:OS3" />}}
A '''Jedi task force''' was sent to [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]] to halt the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] army in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. It ambushed and defeated the [[True Mandalorians]] and captured their leader, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].

==History==
{{Quote|We located the Mandalorians in a small valley, and had the high ground when we surrounded them. I wasn't surprised when they refused to surrender.|Dooku|<ref name="jvs" />}}
After the [[Governor of Galidraan]] falsely informed the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors were murdering "political activists,"<ref name="JF:OS3" /> a Jedi task force of twenty [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was sent to [[Galidraan/Legends|Galidraan]], a snow-covered planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The members of task force were hastily withdrawn from their respective assigments, selected primarily due to their proximity to Galidraan and how quickly they could arrive. Although [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] considered requesting additional reinforcements from the Jedi Council, he ultimately decided against it due to the limitations of hyperspace travel and the urgency of saving civilians who were repotedly "dying". Five [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruisers]], among them the ''[[Acceptance]]''<ref name="jvs" /> and the ''[[Radiant VII/Legends|Radiant VII]]'',<ref name="Antidar DB" /> delivered the task force to the world to put a stop to the Mandalorians. The group's leader, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Komari Vosa]], traveled on the ''Acceptance''.<ref name="jvs" /> The task force immediately ordered the Mandalorians, lead by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], to stand down, an order refused by Fett.

A [[Battle of Galidraan|hard battle]] soon erupted, that left eleven of the task force members killed and the death of all Mandalorians except their leader, who was then captured by the remaining Jedi.
